name: Illusory truth
pattern: Repeated exposure increases average truth judgment under comparable conditions.

name: Correction and belief regression
pattern: Correction can reduce belief initially and partial regression can occur as corrective accessibility decays.

name: Source reliability weighting
pattern: Learned source reliability changes the weight given to otherwise comparable evidence.

name: Accuracy salience and sharing
pattern: Accuracy salience can improve sharing discernment, with heterogeneous effect size.

name: Selective factual emphasis
pattern: Holding the underlying fact-compatible information pool fixed, negative editorial emphasis can produce a more negative observed sample and issue appraisal than a neutral selection policy.

name: Editorial mediation is necessary for the M1.E1 condition difference
pattern: When editorial selection is disabled and conditions receive the same full fact-compatible pool, the editorial-emphasis condition difference disappears.

name: Semantic-equivalent presentation framing
pattern: Holding proposition meaning, truth compatibility and selected content fixed, confirmation framing produces higher active-engagement propensity than refutation framing in the frame-only reference model.

name: Frame by prior-attitude congruence
pattern: The confirmation-refutation engagement contrast is larger for congruent messages than for counter-attitudinal messages in the frame-by-congruence model.

name: Presentation-frame null
pattern: When presentation-frame variation is removed, otherwise identical confirmation and refutation conditions converge.

name: Engagement intent is not M0 Share
pattern: An M1.E2 effect on active-engagement intent must remain separate from the retained M0 Share process and may not silently modify M0 sharing outputs.
